metrics.caveat: Platform reach is modelled by the platform; it is not a count of verified people.
metrics.label: Qualified reach
metrics.numerator: unique people reached in the target segment

metrics.caveat: Bot and duplicate submissions must be excluded at the source.
metrics.label: Qualified leads
metrics.numerator: leads meeting the agreed qualification rule
metrics.privacy: personal data in source; aggregate here

metrics.caveat: Session definitions differ between tools; compare only within one tool.
metrics.label: Conversion rate

metrics.caveat: Spend must use one currency and the same window as the leads.
metrics.label: Cost per qualified lead

metrics.caveat: Recognised revenue, not bookings, unless stated.
metrics.label: New-customer revenue
metrics.numerator: revenue from first purchases or contracts

metrics.caveat: Attribution of spend to customers is model-dependent.
metrics.label: Customer acquisition cost

metrics.caveat: Assumes stable margin and revenue per account.
metrics.label: CAC payback

metrics.caveat: Survey samples have sampling error; report the sample size.
metrics.label: Aided brand awareness

metrics.caveat: Define 'active' once and keep it fixed across cohorts.
metrics.label: Cohort survival
metrics.window: per cohort, at the stated age

metrics.caveat: Exclude involuntary churn only if the rule is stated.
metrics.label: Monthly churn

metrics.caveat: A steady-state model; meaningless with very low churn samples.
metrics.label: Customer lifetime value
metrics.numerator: monthly revenue per account x gross margin

metrics.caveat: Counts approval decisions on this plan's tasks only.
metrics.label: Approval rework rate
Cost per qualified lead
